```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# Standard error (se) and confidence interval (ci):
se <- function(x, ...){sd(x, na.rm = TRUE)/sqrt(length(na.omit(x)))}
ci <- function(x, ...){1.96 * sd(x,na.rm = TRUE)}
```

# Load files

Import KO function files from JGI IMG/MER
```{r Import Files}
#Create vector with desired row order:
sample_order <- c("03NFC", "03PFC", "03Pre", "06NFC", "06PFC", "06Pre", "08NFC", "08PFC", "08Pre", "09NFC", "09PFC", "09Pre", "10NFC", "10PFC", "10Pre", "11NFC", "11PFC", "11Pre", "12NFC", "12PFC", "12Pre", "16NFC", "16PFC", "16Pre")
length(sample_order) #Should be 24

#Methanogen Signature KEGG module (M00617):
meth <- read.csv("~/GitHub/WetlandMesocosm_GHG_Timberlake/data/metaG/Redownloaded/CSV/Meth_CF.csv")
#Reorder rows:
meth <- meth[match(sample_order, meth$Sample), ]

#Dissimilatory sulfate reduction (M00596):
Dissim_SO4_red <- read.csv("~/GitHub/WetlandMesocosm_GHG_Timberlake/data/metaG/IMG_functions_in_depth/M00596_Dissim_SO4_reduction.csv")
#Reorder rows:
Dissim_SO4_red <- Dissim_SO4_red[match(sample_order, Dissim_SO4_red$Sample), ]

#Thiosulfate oxidation by SOX complex (M00595):
ThioSOX <- read.csv("~/GitHub/WetlandMesocosm_GHG_Timberlake/data/metaG/IMG_functions_in_depth/M00595_Thiosulfate_ox_by_SOX.csv")
#Reorder rows:
ThioSOX <- ThioSOX[match(sample_order, ThioSOX$Sample), ]

#Methane oxidation (M00174):
CH4_ox <- read.csv("~/GitHub/WetlandMesocosm_GHG_Timberlake/data/metaG/IMG_functions_in_depth/M00174_MethaneOxidation.csv")
#Reorder rows:
CH4_ox <- CH4_ox[match(sample_order, CH4_ox$Sample), ]
```

```{r Import FeGenie output}
#Gene summary:
FeSummary <- read.csv("../data/metaG/FeGenie_meta_full/FeGenie-geneSummaryRReady.csv", header = T)

FeHeatmap <- read.csv("../data/metaG/FeGenie_meta_full/FeGenie-heatmap-data.csv", header = T)
```

```{r Wrangle FeGenie Heatmap}
# read in metagenomic metadata from IMG, that will be used to match genome IDs to Sample IDs:
metaGmetaD <- read.csv("../data/metaG/metaGmetaData.csv", header = T)

# transpose heatmap:
FeHeatTranspose <- as.data.frame(t(FeHeatmap))
# Fix column names on FeHeatTranspose:
colnames(FeHeatTranspose) <- FeHeatTranspose[1,]
#Now get rid of column 'X' and extra column at bottom:
FeHeatTranspose <- FeHeatTranspose[-c(1,26),]

#String manipulation; cut out extra characters to match IMG taxon oid:
taxon_oid <- as.vector(str_sub(rownames(FeHeatTranspose), start = 2, end = -7))
#Add as new column to FeHeatTranspose:
FeHeatTranspose$taxon_oid <- taxon_oid

#Merge FeHeatTranspose and metaGmetaD by taxon_oid:
FeMerged <- merge(FeHeatTranspose, metaGmetaD)

# Match sample order:
FeMerged <- FeMerged[match(sample_order, FeMerged$Sample), ]
```

```{r wrangle FeSummary}
# purpose: create FeRed dataframe with same layout as KEGG Module data from IMG/MER

# create taxon_oid column
FeSummary$taxon_oid <- as.vector(str_sub(FeSummary$genome.assembly, start = 1, end = -7))

# subset metaGmetaD to get only taxon_oid and Sample:
taxon_oid_sample <- metaGmetaD %>% dplyr::select(c(taxon_oid, Sample))

# create sample column, matched with taxon oid
FeSummary_sample <- merge(FeSummary, taxon_oid_sample, by = "taxon_oid") 

# Filter only Fe Reduction category and Fe Oxidation category: 
FeSummaryRED <- FeSummary %>% dplyr::filter(category == "iron_reduction")
FeSummaryOX <- FeSummary %>% dplyr::filter(category == "iron_oxidation")

# create a df:
FeReduction <- data.frame(matrix(nrow = length(sample_order), ncol = length(unique(FeSummaryRED$HMM))))
rownames(FeReduction) <- sample_order
colnames(FeReduction) <- unique(FeSummaryRED$HMM)

FeOxidation <- data.frame(matrix(nrow = length(sample_order), ncol = length(unique(FeSummaryOX$HMM))))
rownames(FeOxidation) <- sample_order
colnames(FeOxidation) <- unique(FeSummaryOX$HMM)
```

```{r Import metadata and soil data}
#Design file:
design <- read.csv("../data/metaG/design.csv")
design2 <- read.csv("../data/tmg_design.csv")
#Reorder rows of design:
design <- design[match(sample_order, design$Sample), ]

#Remove mock, and box samples from design2. 
rownames(design2) <- design2$sample
design2 <- design2[!(rownames(design2) %in% "MOCK"),]
design2 <- design2[!(design2$source %in% "b"),]
design2 <- design2[!(design2$source %in% "s"),]

# Import soil physicochemical data:
soil <- read.csv("../data/Design_and_soil.csv",  header=T)
```

# Data Wrangling

```{r soil wrangling}
# Start and finish samples, but no field samples (SSF = soil.start.finish)
soil.start.finish <- soil %>%
  filter(time!="field")

SSF.by_time_plant_treatment <- soil.start.finish %>%
  dplyr::select(chamber, time, history, treatment, plant, nh4.mg.l, redox.percent.paint.removed, moisture.percent) %>%
  group_by(chamber)

# No field or start samples (SFO = soil.finishOnly)
soil.finishONLY <- soil %>%
  filter(time!="field")%>%
  filter(time!="start")

SFO.by_time_plant_treatment <- soil.finishONLY %>%
  dplyr::select(-c(g.soil.kcl, no2.no3.mg.l, plant.c.percent, plant.n.percent, plant.dry.mass.g, CEC., HM.)) %>%
  group_by(chamber)

# Soil history analysis prep
soil_hist <- soil |>
  mutate(history = recode_values(history, "FW" ~ "W", "FD" ~ "D", default = history)) |>
  filter(history %in% c("W", "D")) |>
  filter(treatment %in% c("F", "D", "W"))

# Correct erroneous "D" and "W" values for field soil samples, converting them to "F" for field
soil_hist <- soil_hist |>
  mutate(treatment = if_else(time == "field", "F", treatment))

# Mesocosm blocking factor for soil_hist
soil_hist <- soil_hist |>
  mutate(group = factor(if_else(row_number() <= 4, as.character(chamber), substr(chamber, 1, 2))))

# Field samples only
soil_hist_F <- soil_hist |>
  filter(treatment == "F")

# Remove field from soil_hist
soil_hist <- soil_hist |>
  filter(treatment != "F")
```

```{r Sample IDs to rownames}
#For metagenomic data, make sample IDs rownames in a new data frame, to be further subsetted to numeric only data:
methNumerical <- meth
rownames(methNumerical) <- methNumerical$Sample

Dissim_SO4_redNumerical <- Dissim_SO4_red
rownames(Dissim_SO4_redNumerical) <- Dissim_SO4_redNumerical$Sample

ThioSOXNumerical <- ThioSOX
rownames(ThioSOXNumerical) <- ThioSOXNumerical$Sample

CH4_oxNumerical <- CH4_ox
rownames(CH4_oxNumerical) <- CH4_oxNumerical$Sample

FeGenieNumerical <- FeMerged
rownames(FeGenieNumerical) <- FeGenieNumerical$Sample 
```

```{r make numeric only data frames for functional genes}
methNumerical <- methNumerical[,-(1:2)]
dim(methNumerical)

Dissim_SO4_redNumerical <- Dissim_SO4_redNumerical[,-(1:2)]

ThioSOXNumerical <- ThioSOXNumerical[,-(1:2)]

CH4_oxNumerical <- CH4_oxNumerical[,-(1:2)]

# Keep columns 2:14 and convert them from character to numeric
FeGenieNumerical <- FeGenieNumerical[, 2:14] |>
  dplyr::mutate(dplyr::across(everything(), as.numeric))
```

```{r Convert gene counts to relative abundance}
methRA <- make_relative(as.matrix(methNumerical))

Dissim_SO4_redRA <- make_relative(as.matrix(Dissim_SO4_redNumerical))

ThioSOXRA <- make_relative(as.matrix(ThioSOXNumerical))

CH4_oxRA <- make_relative(as.matrix(CH4_oxNumerical))

FeGenieRA <- make_relative(as.matrix(FeGenieNumerical))

FeReductionRA <- make_relative(as.matrix(FeReduction))

FeOxidationRA <- make_relative(as.matrix(FeOxidation))
```

```{r lists of start and finish samples}
#Make a list for start and finish, so you don't have to re-write it each time below
start_metaG_samples <- c("03Pre", "06Pre", "08Pre", "09Pre", "10Pre", "11Pre", "12Pre", "16Pre")
finish_metaG_samples <- c("03NFC", "03PFC", "06NFC", "06PFC", "08NFC", "08PFC", "09NFC", "09PFC", "10NFC", "10PFC", "11NFC", "11PFC", "12NFC", "12PFC", "16NFC", "16PFC")
```

```{r Subset start and finish samples from all gene sets}
methRA_start <- methRA[start_metaG_samples, ]
methRA_finish <- methRA[finish_metaG_samples, ]

Dissim_SO4_redRA_start <- Dissim_SO4_redRA[start_metaG_samples, ]
Dissim_SO4_redRA_finish <- Dissim_SO4_redRA[finish_metaG_samples, ]

ThioSOXRA_start <- ThioSOXRA[start_metaG_samples, ]
ThioSOXRA_finish <- ThioSOXRA[finish_metaG_samples, ]

CH4_oxRA_start <- CH4_oxRA[start_metaG_samples, ]
CH4_oxRA_finish <- CH4_oxRA[finish_metaG_samples, ]

FeGenieRA_start <- FeGenieRA[start_metaG_samples,]
FeGenieRA_finish <- FeGenieRA[finish_metaG_samples,]

FeReductionRA_start <- FeReductionRA[start_metaG_samples,]
FeReductionRA_finish <- FeReductionRA[finish_metaG_samples,]

FeOxidationRA_start <- FeOxidationRA[start_metaG_samples,]
FeOxidationRA_finish <- FeOxidationRA[finish_metaG_samples,]
```

```{r modify 'design' rownames}
#Make metaG sample ID's the rownames on 'design'. Then drop design$Sample:
rownames(design) <- design$Sample
design <- design[,2:4]

# Add mesocosm ID to design
design$mesocosm_ID <- as.factor(substr(rownames(design), 1, 2))

# Mesocosm blocking factor for soil_hist
soil_hist <- soil_hist |>
  mutate(group = factor(if_else(row_number() <= 4, as.character(chamber), substr(chamber, 1, 2))))
```

```{r combine RA and design data frames}
# Make data frames from gene set relative abundance (RA) data frames and design
methRA_design <- cbind(design, methRA)
Dissim_SO4_redRA_design <- cbind(design, Dissim_SO4_redRA)
ThioSOXRA_design <- cbind(design, ThioSOXRA)
CH4_oxRA_design <- cbind(design, CH4_oxRA)
FeGenieRA_design <- cbind(design, FeGenieRA)
FeReductionRA_design <- cbind(design, FeReductionRA)
FeOxidationRA_design <- cbind(design, FeOxidationRA)
```

```{r pool plant halves to 8 mesocosms}
# Collapse +Plant/-Plant halves to one row per mesocosm (finish samples only).
# Relative abundances are averaged
pool_mesocosm <- function(RA_design) {
  RA_design |>
    tibble::rownames_to_column("sample") |>
    filter(Plant != "_pre") |>
    group_by(mesocosm_ID, Hist, Treat) |>
    summarise(across(where(is.numeric), mean), .groups = "drop") |>
    arrange(mesocosm_ID) |>
    tibble::column_to_rownames("mesocosm_ID")
}

methRA_pooled <- pool_mesocosm(methRA_design)

# Community matrix (N=8) and whole-plot design
methRA_pooled_comm <- methRA_pooled |> dplyr::select(-c(Hist, Treat))
methRA_pooled_design <- methRA_pooled |> dplyr::select(Hist, Treat)

stopifnot(nrow(methRA_pooled_comm) == 8)
methBC_pooled <- vegan::vegdist(methRA_pooled_comm, method = "bray")

# Pool every gene set that has a *RA_design object defined above.
# Each element holds: comm (N=8 matrix), design, BC (Bray-Curtis), pcoa.
RA_design_list <- list(
  meth           = methRA_design,
  Dissim_SO4_red = Dissim_SO4_redRA_design,
  ThioSOX        = ThioSOXRA_design,
  CH4_ox         = CH4_oxRA_design,
  FeGenie        = FeGenieRA_design,
  FeReduction    = FeReductionRA_design,
  FeOxidation    = FeOxidationRA_design
)

pooled <- lapply(RA_design_list, function(x) {
  p <- pool_mesocosm(x)
  comm <- p |> dplyr::select(-c(Hist, Treat))
  BC <- vegan::vegdist(comm, method = "bray")
  list(
    comm = comm,
    design = p |> dplyr::select(Hist, Treat),
    BC = BC,
    pcoa = cmdscale(BC, k = 2, eig = TRUE, add = TRUE)
  )
})
```

```{r GHG T1 concentration analysis}
# Version of ghg with labels for T1 through T4 analysis:
ghg2 <- read.csv("../data/TMG_GHG-Flux_Pub_3.csv", header=TRUE)

# FIX c2o TYPO IN ghg2:
colnames(ghg2)[18] <- "co2_ppm"

# ghg2, select T1 through T4, and all ppm measurements:
ghg_ppm <- ghg2 %>%
  dplyr::select('date', 'chamber', 'timepoint', 'plant', 'ch4_ppm', 'co2_ppm', 'n2o_ppm')%>%
  dplyr::filter(date !='7/24/2016')

# Set factors:
ghg_ppm$chamber <- as.factor(ghg_ppm$chamber)
ghg_ppm$date <- as.factor(ghg_ppm$date)

# Change design$box to design$chamber in order to join with ghg$chamber
colnames(meta)[2] <- "chamber"

ghg_ppm <- ghg_ppm %>%
  left_join(meta[,-c(3, 4, 7, 8, 9)], by="chamber")

# Add new date column, to shorten:
ghg_ppm$date_short <- ghg_ppm$date
# remove "/2016" from date_short:
ghg_ppm$date_short <- str_remove(ghg_ppm$date_short, "/2016")
```

```{r Calculate T0s from WRC static chamber monitoring}
# read in compiled T0 data:
WRC_T0s <- read.csv("../data/WRC_T0s_for_TMG_ambient_calculation.csv")

# Set Sample_Date as factor:
WRC_T0s$Sample_Date <- as.factor(WRC_T0s$Sample_Date)

# calculate averages within each month:
CO2_T0_monthly_avg <- aggregate(T0_CO2_ppm ~ Sample_Date, data = WRC_T0s, FUN = mean, na.rm = TRUE)
CH4_T0_monthly_avg <- aggregate(T0_CH4_ppm ~ Sample_Date, data = WRC_T0s, FUN = mean, na.rm = TRUE)
N2O_T0_monthly_avg <- aggregate(T0_N2O_ppm ~ Sample_Date, data = WRC_T0s, FUN = mean, na.rm = TRUE)

# Average the two years of August data:
CO2_T0_monthly_avg[nrow(CO2_T0_monthly_avg)+1, "T0_CO2_ppm"] <- mean(c(CO2_T0_monthly_avg[1, "T0_CO2_ppm"], CO2_T0_monthly_avg[2, "T0_CO2_ppm"]), na.rm = TRUE)

CH4_T0_monthly_avg[nrow(CH4_T0_monthly_avg)+1, "T0_CH4_ppm"] <- mean(c(CH4_T0_monthly_avg[1, "T0_CH4_ppm"], CH4_T0_monthly_avg[2, "T0_CH4_ppm"]), na.rm = TRUE)

N2O_T0_monthly_avg[nrow(N2O_T0_monthly_avg)+1, "T0_N2O_ppm"] <- mean(c(N2O_T0_monthly_avg[1, "T0_N2O_ppm"], N2O_T0_monthly_avg[2, "T0_N2O_ppm"]), na.rm = TRUE)

# Add in the name:
CO2_T0_monthly_avg$Sample_Date <- factor(c("Aug_2022", "August_2021", "Jul_2022", "June_2022", "August_21_22"))
CH4_T0_monthly_avg$Sample_Date <- factor(c("Aug_2022", "August_2021", "Jul_2022", "June_2022", "August_21_22"))
N2O_T0_monthly_avg$Sample_Date <- factor(c("Aug_2022", "August_2021", "Jul_2022", "June_2022", "August_21_22"))
```

```{r wrangle T0 averages for flux calculation}
# bind together the three GHGs:
T0_averages_combined <- CH4_T0_monthly_avg %>%
  cbind(CO2_T0_monthly_avg$T0_CO2_ppm) %>%
  cbind(N2O_T0_monthly_avg$T0_N2O_ppm)

# drop the two August monthly:
T0_averages_combined <- T0_averages_combined[3:5,]

# Rename 'Sample_Date' in T0_averages_combined to 'date' to match the 'ghg_flux' column
colnames(T0_averages_combined)[1] <- "date"

# Add chamber as NAs:
T0_averages_combined$chamber <- NA

# Rename GHG columns to match ghg_flux:
colnames(T0_averages_combined)[2:4] <- c("ch4_ppm", "co2_ppm", "n2o_ppm")

# Add time columns to match ghg_flux:
T0_averages_combined$time_min <- 0
T0_averages_combined$time <- 0

# Add month column:
T0_averages_combined$month <- c("July", "June", "August")
```

```{r GHG flux wrangling}
# Format a dataframe for 'gasfluxes' package:
ghg_flux <- ghg2[,c(1:2, 12, 15:19)]

# Remove 7/24/2016 from data frame, as per Gina's advice
ghg_flux <- ghg_flux %>%
  dplyr::filter(date !='7/24/2016')

# Combine 'date' and 'chamber' strings to create a unique ID:
ghg_flux$ID <- paste(ghg_flux$date, ghg_flux$chamber)

# convert Volume (cm^3) to Volume (m^3):
ghg_flux$V <- (ghg_flux$Vol..cm3. * (1/1e+06))

# Copy 'Area..m2.' to a new column named 'A':
ghg_flux$A <- ghg_flux$Area..m2.

# Convert time in minutes to time in hours:
ghg_flux$time <- (ghg_flux$time_min * (1/60))

# Bind T0s from WRC:
ghg_flux_w_T0 <- ghg_flux

# Add in month column that takes date strings and matches them to "July", "June", "August":
# Create a vector of month names
month_names <- c("January", "February", "March", "April", "May", "June",
                 "July", "August", "September", "October", "November", "December")

# Extract the month as a number and convert it to a month name
ghg_flux_w_T0 <- ghg_flux_w_T0 %>%
  mutate(
    month = month_names[as.numeric(substr(date, 1, 1))]
  )

# Copy July and June rows because there are two July and June sampling dates:
T0_averages_combined <- rbind(T0_averages_combined, T0_averages_combined[1,])
T0_averages_combined <- rbind(T0_averages_combined, T0_averages_combined[2,])

# Add TMG-style dates to match with ghg_flux:
T0_averages_combined$date_TMG <- c("7/11/2016", "6/13/2016", "8/11/2016", "7/25/2016", "6/28/2016")

# For loop:
for (unique_date in unique(ghg_flux_w_T0$date)) {
  for (unique_chamber in unique(ghg_flux_w_T0$chamber)) {
    
    # Filter the monthly average corresponding to the current date
    month_avg <- T0_averages_combined %>% filter(date_TMG == unique_date)
    
    # Skip if there is no corresponding monthly average for the date
    if (nrow(month_avg) == 0) next
    
    # Create a new row with time = 0 and the averages for the current date and chamber
    new_row <- data.frame(
      date = unique_date,
      chamber = unique_chamber,
      time = month_avg$time,
      time_min = month_avg$time_min,
      ch4_ppm = month_avg$ch4_ppm,
      co2_ppm = month_avg$co2_ppm,
      n2o_ppm = month_avg$n2o_ppm,
      month = month_avg$month
    )
    
    # Bind the new row to ghg_flux
    ghg_flux_w_T0 <- bind_rows(ghg_flux_w_T0, new_row)
  }
}

# Reorder rows by date, chamber, and time:
ghg_flux_w_T0 <- ghg_flux_w_T0 %>%
  arrange(date, chamber, time)

# Copy some of rows following T0s onto T0s (ID, V, A):
# Define the columns with missing values to be filled from the row below
columns_to_fill <- c("ID", "V", "A")

# Loop through the rows from the bottom to the top to fill missing values from the row below
for (i in (nrow(ghg_flux_w_T0) - 1):1) {
  # Check for missing values in the specified columns
  missing_values <- is.na(ghg_flux_w_T0[i, columns_to_fill])
  
  # If there are missing values, copy the values from the row below
  if (any(missing_values)) {
    ghg_flux_w_T0[i, columns_to_fill][missing_values] <- ghg_flux_w_T0[i + 1, columns_to_fill][missing_values]
  }
}

# Convert ppm to mg/m^3, based on https://www.cdc.gov/niosh/docs/2004-101/calc.html (based on 25°C and 1 atm):
# y mg/m3 = (x ppm)(molar mass)/24.45
  # 24.45 is the volume (liters) of a mole (gram molecular weight) of a gas or vapor when the pressure is at 1 atmosphere (760 torr or 760 mm Hg) and at 25°C

# CH4 mg/m3
 # C is the package 'gasfluxes' abbreviation for concentration. 16.04 g/mol = molar mass of CH4
ghg_flux_w_T0$C_ch4 <- ((ghg_flux_w_T0$ch4_ppm * 16.04)/24.45)

# CO2 mg/m3
 # molar mass of CO2 = 44.01 g/mol
ghg_flux_w_T0$C_co2 <- ((ghg_flux_w_T0$co2_ppm * 44.01)/24.45)

# N2O mg/m3
 # molar mass of N2O = 44.013 g/mol
ghg_flux_w_T0$C_n2o <-  ((ghg_flux_w_T0$n2o_ppm * 44.013)/24.45)

# Split off data frames for each greenhouse gas:
ch4_flux_input_w_T0 <- ghg_flux_w_T0[,c(9:12, 14)]
co2_flux_input_w_T0 <- ghg_flux_w_T0[,c(9:12, 15)]
n2o_flux_input_w_T0 <- ghg_flux_w_T0[,c(9:12, 16)]

# Rename C_ghg columns to 'C':
colnames(ch4_flux_input_w_T0)[5] <- "C"
colnames(co2_flux_input_w_T0)[5] <- "C"
colnames(n2o_flux_input_w_T0)[5] <- "C"

# Must omit NAs before using gasfluxes():
ch4_flux_input_w_T0 <- na.omit(ch4_flux_input_w_T0)
co2_flux_input_w_T0 <- na.omit(co2_flux_input_w_T0)

# n2o_flux_input has negative values, will need to be converted to NAs, then all NAs omitted
n2o_flux_input_w_T0$C[n2o_flux_input_w_T0$C<0] <- NA
n2o_flux_input_w_T0 <- na.omit(n2o_flux_input_w_T0)
```

```{r Make T0 flux dataframes' V and A numeric}
ch4_flux_input_w_T0$V <- as.numeric(ch4_flux_input_w_T0$V)
ch4_flux_input_w_T0$A <- as.numeric(ch4_flux_input_w_T0$A)

co2_flux_input_w_T0$V <- as.numeric(co2_flux_input_w_T0$V)
co2_flux_input_w_T0$A <- as.numeric(co2_flux_input_w_T0$A)

n2o_flux_input_w_T0$V <- as.numeric(n2o_flux_input_w_T0$V)
n2o_flux_input_w_T0$A <- as.numeric(n2o_flux_input_w_T0$A)
```

```{r GHG flux calculation}

co2_flux.results_w_T0 <- gasfluxes(co2_flux_input_w_T0, method = c("linear","robust linear", "HMR"), plot = T)
n2o_flux.results_w_T0 <- gasfluxes(n2o_flux_input_w_T0, method = c("linear","robust linear", "HMR"), plot = T)
```

## GHG wrangling

Mesocosm-level GHG time series (mean of +plant and -plant fluxes), final-timepoint fluxes, and cumulative fluxes for envfit against the N = 8 pooled metagenomic ordinations:
```{r wrangling GHG data}
# Mesocosms with pooled metagenomes
metaG_mesocosms <- c("03", "06", "08", "09", "10", "11", "12", "16")

# Trapezoidal area under the flux-vs-time curve (same result as MESS::auc(type = "linear"))
trapz <- function(x, y) sum(diff(x) * (head(y, -1) + tail(y, -1)) / 2)

# 1. Mesocosm-level time series: average +plant and -plant chambers
GHG_pooled <- select_fluxes_combined_w_T0 |>
  as_tibble() |>
  mutate(
    date = as.Date(sub(" .*", "", ID), format = "%m/%d/%Y"),
    # ID format is "m/d/Y <box><N|P>", e.g. "6/13/2016 3N" -> mesocosm "03"
    mesocosm_ID = sprintf("%02d", as.integer(sub("^\\S+ (\\d+)[NP]$", "\\1", ID))),
    Timepoint = match(date, sort(unique(date))),
    day = as.numeric(date - min(date))
  ) |>
  filter(mesocosm_ID %in% metaG_mesocosms) |>
  group_by(mesocosm_ID, Timepoint, date, day) |>
  summarise(across(c(f0_CH4, f0_CO2, f0_N2O), \(x) mean(x, na.rm = TRUE)), .groups = "drop") |>
  arrange(mesocosm_ID, Timepoint)

stopifnot(all(count(GHG_pooled, mesocosm_ID)$n == 5))

# 2. Final timepoint (T5), row-named by mesocosm_ID
GHG_T5 <- GHG_pooled |>
  filter(Timepoint == 5) |>
  select(mesocosm_ID, f0_CH4, f0_CO2, f0_N2O) |>
  tibble::column_to_rownames("mesocosm_ID")

# 3. Cumulative flux over T1-T5 (trapezoid on actual days elapsed), row-named by mesocosm_ID
GHG_Cumulative <- GHG_pooled |>
  group_by(mesocosm_ID) |>
  summarise(across(c(f0_CH4, f0_CO2, f0_N2O), \(y) trapz(day, y)), .groups = "drop") |>
  tibble::column_to_rownames("mesocosm_ID")

# Rows must match the pooled ordination order
stopifnot(identical(rownames(GHG_T5), rownames(pooled$meth$pcoa$points)),
          identical(rownames(GHG_Cumulative), rownames(GHG_T5)))
```

```{r pooled environmental data for envfit}

# SFO chamber IDs are e.g. "03NC"; first two characters = mesocosm_ID.
```

## dbplsr

Distance-based partial least squares regression:
```{r dbplsr}
# Leave-one-block-out CV (Q2) for the combined model.
# predict.dbplsr() did not reproduce in-sample fitted values, so kernel PLS1 is implemented directly
# (verified to match dbplsr fitted values in-sample).
kpls1_predict <- function(K, Kn, y, ncomp) {
  ybar <- mean(y); yd <- y - ybar
  out <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow(Kn), ncomp); pred <- rep(ybar, nrow(Kn))
  for (j in 1:ncomp) {
    t <- K %*% yd; tn <- Kn %*% yd; tt <- sum(t^2)
    q <- sum(t * yd) / tt
    pred <- pred + tn * q; out[, j] <- pred
    yd <- yd - t * q
    Kt <- K %*% t
    Kn <- Kn - tn %*% crossprod(t, K) / tt - (Kn %*% t) %*% t(t) / tt +
      tn %*% t(t) * as.numeric(crossprod(t, Kt)) / tt^2
    K <- K - t %*% crossprod(t, K) / tt - Kt %*% t(t) / tt +
      t %*% t(t) * as.numeric(crossprod(t, Kt)) / tt^2
  }
  out
}

# Gower-centered kernel rows for held-out samples (new x train squared distances)
Gnew_from_D2 <- function(D2train, d2new)
  -0.5 * (sweep(d2new, 2, rowMeans(D2train)) - rowMeans(d2new) + mean(D2train))

D2_full <- as.matrix(Dissim_SO4_redBC)^2
y_all   <- GHG_metaG$f0_CH4
block   <- substr(rownames(D2_full), 1, 2)
K_max   <- 8

cv_pred   <- matrix(NA_real_, length(y_all), K_max)
null_pred <- numeric(length(y_all))
for (b in unique(block)) {
  te <- block == b; tr <- !te
  J    <- diag(sum(tr)) - 1 / sum(tr)
  D2tr <- D2_full[tr, tr]
  Gtr  <- -0.5 * J %*% D2tr %*% J
  Gte  <- Gnew_from_D2(D2tr, D2_full[te, tr, drop = FALSE])
  cv_pred[te, ] <- kpls1_predict(Gtr, Gte, y_all[tr], K_max)
  null_pred[te] <- mean(y_all[tr])
}

q2_tbl <- data.frame(
  ncomp = 1:K_max,
  PRESS = colSums((y_all - cv_pred)^2),
  Q2    = 1 - colSums((y_all - cv_pred)^2) / sum((y_all - null_pred)^2),
  RMSEP = sqrt(colMeans((y_all - cv_pred)^2))
)
q2_tbl
```

Pooled (N = 8) envfit of every gene-set ordination against soil chemistry plus GHG flux, using (i) final-timepoint (T5) fluxes and (ii) cumulative fluxes. With N = 8 and 21 variables per run, treat p-values as exploratory; `p_adj` is Benjamini-Hochberg within each gene set and environmental set.
```{r pooled envfit}
set.seed(5821)

fits <- lapply(pooled, \(p) {
  lapply(env_list, \(e) {
    stopifnot(identical(rownames(e), rownames(p$pcoa$points)))
    envfit(p$pcoa$points, e, permutations = 9999)
  })
})

envfit_table <- lapply(names(fits), \(g) {
  lapply(names(fits[[g]]), \(s) {
    v <- fits[[g]][[s]]$vectors
    data.frame(gene_set = g, env_set = s, variable = names(v$r), r2 = v$r, p = v$pvals)
  }) |> bind_rows()
}) |>
  bind_rows() |>
  group_by(gene_set, env_set) |>
  mutate(p_adj = p.adjust(p, method = "BH")) |>
  ungroup()

# Vectors with unadjusted p <= 0.05
envfit_table |>
  filter(p <= 0.05) |>
  arrange(gene_set, env_set, p)
```

```{r pooled PCoA biplot function}
plot_pooled_pcoa <- function(gene_set, env_set, alpha = 0.05, title = gene_set) {
  p <- pooled[[gene_set]]
  fit <- fits[[gene_set]][[env_set]]
  eig <- p$pcoa$eig
  pct <- round(100 * eig[1:2] / sum(eig), 1)

  pts <- data.frame(p$pcoa$points, p$design) |>
    mutate(History = recode(Hist, d = "Dry", w = "Wet"),
           Treatment = recode(Treat, d = "Dry", w = "Wet"))

  # Unit arrows scaled by sqrt(r2), as in vegan's plot.envfit
  vec <- as.data.frame(fit$vectors$arrows * sqrt(fit$vectors$r))
  names(vec) <- c("X1", "X2")
  vec$variable <- rownames(vec)
  vec$p <- fit$vectors$pvals
  vec <- vec[vec$p <= alpha, , drop = FALSE]

  # Rescale arrows so the longest sits within the point cloud (lengths are relative only)
  if (nrow(vec) > 0) {
    mul <- 0.8 * max(abs(pts[, c("X1", "X2")])) / max(abs(vec[, c("X1", "X2")]))
    vec[, c("X1", "X2")] <- vec[, c("X1", "X2")] * mul
  }

  ggplot(pts, aes(X1, X2)) +
    geom_point(aes(shape = History, colour = Treatment), size = 4, stroke = 1.5) +
    geom_segment(data = vec, aes(x = 0, y = 0, xend = X1, yend = X2),
                 arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.2, "cm")), alpha = 0.5) +
    geom_text(data = vec, aes(X1, X2, label = variable), size = 3.5, vjust = -0.5) +
    labs(x = paste0("PCoA 1 (", pct[1], "%)"), y = paste0("PCoA 2 (", pct[2], "%)"),
         title = title) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(panel.grid = element_blank())
}
```

```{r pooled PCoA biplots: T5, fig.width=10, fig.height=16}
ggarrange(plotlist = lapply(names(pooled), \(g) plot_pooled_pcoa(g, "T5")),
          ncol = 2, nrow = 4, common.legend = TRUE, legend = "right")
```



```{r DBPLSR barplots 2}
# read in formatted table of dbplsr component 2 adjusted R2 results:
dbplsr_comp2_dec <- read.csv("~/GitHub/WetlandMesocosm_GHG_Timberlake/data/dbplsr_comp2_dec.csv")

methane.dbplsr.Fig <- ggplot(data = dbplsr_comp2_dec, aes(x = Timepoint, y = GHG, fill = Comp2_adjR2)) +
  geom_tile() +
  facet_wrap(~Dist_matrix) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "blue", high = "red") +
  theme_bw() +
  # Remove plot grid lines
  theme(panel.grid.major = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank()) + 
  # Set axis title and text properties, tick marks, and labels
  theme(text = element_text(size = 14),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 14),  
        axis.title.y = element_text(margin = margin(r = 10)),
        panel.border = element_rect(colour = "black", linewidth = 1),
        strip.text = element_text(size = 14),
        legend.position = "right",
        legend.title = element_text(size = 14),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 14)) + 
  theme(axis.ticks.length = unit(0.3, "cm")) + 
  labs(x = "", y = "Methane Flux", title = "") +
  theme(rect = element_rect(fill = "transparent")) +
  theme(plot.background = element_rect(color = NA)) +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_blank(),  # Remove y-axis text
        axis.ticks.y = element_blank()) + # Remove y-axis ticks
  scale_x_discrete(expand = c(0, 0))+  # Remove x-axis margin
  scale_y_discrete(expand = c(0, 0))  # Remove y-axis margin

methane.dbplsr.Fig

#ggsave("../figures/Fe_S_manuscript/methane_dbplsr_plot.png", plot=methane.dbplsr.plot, device="png", path=NULL, scale=1, width=7, height=4, dpi=600, limitsize=TRUE, bg = "white")
```

### Mantel tests

#### Overall comparisons

```{r Mantel tests}
# Using Pat Schloss code club as reference: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=EXNOgmUyPfY

# mantel tests:

# Sulfate reduction ~ Methanogen
vegan::mantel(methBC, SO4_red_combinedBC, permutations = 10000, set.seed(42))
```

```{r Mantel heatmap figure (overall comparisons)}
# List of distance matrices
matrices <- list(
  "Iron reduction" = FeReductionBC,
  "Assimilatory\n sulfate reduction" = Assim_SO4_redBC,
  "Dissimilatory\n sulfate reduction" = Dissim_SO4_redBC,
  "Sox pathway" = ThioSOXBC,
  "Denitrification" = denitBC,
  "DNRA" = DNRABC,
  Methanogenesis = methBC
)

# Initialize matrices to store r and p-values
n <- length(matrices)
r_matrix <- matrix(NA, n, n)
p_matrix <- matrix(NA, n, n)
rownames(r_matrix) <- colnames(r_matrix) <- names(matrices)
rownames(p_matrix) <- colnames(p_matrix) <- names(matrices)

# Set the seed ONCE before the loops start
set.seed(42)

# Run Mantel tests
for (i in 1:n) {
  for (j in 1:n) {
    test <- vegan::mantel(matrices[[i]], matrices[[j]], permutations = 9999)
    r_matrix[i, j] <- test$statistic
    p_matrix[i, j] <- test$signif
  }
}

# Melt matrices for ggplot
r_melt <- melt(r_matrix)
p_melt <- melt(p_matrix)
combined <- data.frame(
  Var1 = r_melt$Var1,
  Var2 = r_melt$Var2,
  r = round(r_melt$value, 2),
  p = p_melt$value
)

# Create label
combined$label <- mapply(function(r, p) {
  if (p < 0.01) {
    sci <- formatC(p, format = "e", digits = 1)  # e.g., "8.0e-03"
    parts <- strsplit(sci, "e")[[1]]
    coeff <- parts[1]
    exponent <- as.numeric(parts[2])
    paste0("atop(italic(r)==", formatC(r, digits = 2, format = "f"),
           ", italic(p)==", coeff, " %*% 10^", exponent, ")")
  } else {
    paste0("atop(italic(r)==", formatC(r, digits = 2, format = "f"),
           ", italic(p)==", formatC(p, format = "f", digits = 2), ")")
  }
}, combined$r, combined$p)

# Define consistent matrix order
matrix_names <- names(matrices)

# Set both Var1 and Var2 to the same factor levels
combined$Var1 <- factor(combined$Var1, levels = matrix_names)
combined$Var2 <- factor(combined$Var2, levels = matrix_names)

# Mask upper triangle: Var1 is column (X), Var2 is row (Y)
combined$mask <- match(combined$Var1, matrix_names) > match(combined$Var2, matrix_names)

# Flag diagonal cells
combined$is_diagonal <- as.character(combined$Var1) == as.character(combined$Var2)

# Set text color: black for diagonal, white otherwise
combined$text_color <- ifelse(combined$is_diagonal, "black", "white")

# Plot heatmap with masked lower triangle
Mantel_heat_overall <- ggplot(combined, aes(Var1, Var2)) +
  geom_tile(data = subset(combined, mask), fill = "white", color = "white") +
  geom_tile(data = subset(combined, !mask), aes(fill = r), color = "white") +
  geom_text(data = subset(combined, !mask), aes(label = label, color = text_color), size = 4, parse = TRUE) +
  scale_color_identity() +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "viridis", name = "Mantel r", begin = 0, end = 1) +
  scale_y_discrete(limits = rev(matrix_names)) +  # reverse Y-axis
  scale_x_discrete(limits = matrix_names) +  # non reversed X-axis
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(x = "", y = "", title = "") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
  axis.text = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
  axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
  axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
  panel.grid.major = element_blank(),  # remove major grid lines
  panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),  # remove minor grid lines
  axis.line = element_blank()          # optional: remove axis lines
)

Mantel_heat_overall
```

```{r Mantel matrix: Wet History}
# Distance matrices, wet history only
matrices <- list(
  "Iron reduction" = FeReductionRA_WetHist_BC,
  "Assimilatory\n sulfate reduction" = Assim_SO4_redRA_WetHist_BC,
  "Dissimilatory\n sulfate reduction" = Dissim_SO4_redRA_WetHist_BC,
  Methanogenesis = methRA_WetHist_BC
)

# Initialize matrices to store r and p-values
n <- length(matrices)
r_matrix <- matrix(NA, n, n)
p_matrix <- matrix(NA, n, n)
rownames(r_matrix) <- colnames(r_matrix) <- names(matrices)
rownames(p_matrix) <- colnames(p_matrix) <- names(matrices)

# Set the seed ONCE before the loops start
set.seed(42)

# Run Mantel tests
for (i in 1:n) {
  for (j in 1:n) {
    test <- vegan::mantel(matrices[[i]], matrices[[j]], permutations = 9999)
    r_matrix[i, j] <- test$statistic
    p_matrix[i, j] <- test$signif
  }
}

# Melt matrices for ggplot
r_melt <- melt(r_matrix)
p_melt <- melt(p_matrix)
combined1 <- data.frame(
  Var1 = r_melt$Var1,
  Var2 = r_melt$Var2,
  r = round(r_melt$value, 2),
  p = p_melt$value
)

# Create label
combined1$label <- mapply(function(r, p) {
  if (p < 0.01) {
    sci <- formatC(p, format = "e", digits = 1)  # e.g., "8.0e-03"
    parts <- strsplit(sci, "e")[[1]]
    coeff <- parts[1]
    exponent <- as.numeric(parts[2])
    paste0("atop(italic(r)==", formatC(r, digits = 2, format = "f"),
           ", italic(p)==", coeff, " %*% 10^", exponent, ")")
  } else {
    paste0("atop(italic(r)==", formatC(r, digits = 2, format = "f"),
           ", italic(p)==", formatC(p, format = "f", digits = 2), ")")
  }
}, combined1$r, combined1$p)

# Define consistent matrix order
matrix_names <- names(matrices)

# Set both Var1 and Var2 to the same factor levels
combined1$Var1 <- factor(combined1$Var1, levels = matrix_names)
combined1$Var2 <- factor(combined1$Var2, levels = matrix_names)

# Mask upper triangle: Var1 is column (X), Var2 is row (Y)
combined1$mask <- match(combined1$Var1, matrix_names) > match(combined1$Var2, matrix_names)

# Flag diagonal cells
combined1$is_diagonal <- as.character(combined1$Var1) == as.character(combined1$Var2)

# Set text color: black for diagonal, white otherwise
combined1$text_color <- ifelse(combined1$is_diagonal, "black", "white")
```

```{r Mantel heatmap: Dry Treatment}
    test <- vegan::mantel(matrices[[i]], matrices[[j]], permutations = 9999)
    r_matrix[i, j] <- test$statistic
    p_matrix[i, j] <- test$signif
  }
}

# Melt matrices for ggplot
r_melt <- melt(r_matrix)
p_melt <- melt(p_matrix)
combined4 <- data.frame(
  Var1 = r_melt$Var1,
  Var2 = r_melt$Var2,
  r = round(r_melt$value, 2),
  p = p_melt$value
)

# Create label
combined4$label <- mapply(function(r, p) {
  if (p < 0.01) {
    sci <- formatC(p, format = "e", digits = 1)  # e.g., "8.0e-03"
    parts <- strsplit(sci, "e")[[1]]
    coeff <- parts[1]
    exponent <- as.numeric(parts[2])
    paste0("atop(italic(r)==", formatC(r, digits = 2, format = "f"),
           ", italic(p)==", coeff, " %*% 10^", exponent, ")")
  } else {
    paste0("atop(italic(r)==", formatC(r, digits = 2, format = "f"),
           ", italic(p)==", formatC(p, format = "f", digits = 2), ")")
  }
}, combined4$r, combined4$p)

# Define consistent matrix order
matrix_names <- names(matrices)

# Set both Var1 and Var2 to the same factor levels
combined4$Var1 <- factor(combined4$Var1, levels = matrix_names)
combined4$Var2 <- factor(combined4$Var2, levels = matrix_names)

# Mask upper triangle: Var1 is column (X), Var2 is row (Y)
combined4$mask <- match(combined4$Var1, matrix_names) > match(combined4$Var2, matrix_names)

# Flag diagonal cells
combined4$is_diagonal <- as.character(combined4$Var1) == as.character(combined4$Var2)

# Set text color: black for diagonal, white otherwise
combined4$text_color <- ifelse(combined4$is_diagonal, "black", "white")
```

```{r Global r min and r max for viridis scale}
# Step 1: Get global min and max r values
global_r_min <- min(c(combined1$r, combined2$r, combined3$r, combined4$r), na.rm = TRUE)
global_r_max <- max(c(combined1$r, combined2$r, combined3$r, combined4$r), na.rm = TRUE)
```

```{r Heatmap 1: Wet History}
# Plot heatmap with masked lower triangle
MantelHeatHydro_1 <- ggplot(combined1, aes(Var1, Var2)) +
  geom_tile(data = subset(combined1, mask), fill = "white", color = "white") +
  geom_tile(data = subset(combined1, !mask), aes(fill = r), color = "white") +
  geom_text(data = subset(combined1, !mask), aes(label = label, color = text_color), size = 4, parse = TRUE) +
  scale_color_identity()+  # use actual color values from the data
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "viridis", name = "Mantel r", limits = c(global_r_min, global_r_max)) +
  scale_y_discrete(limits = rev(matrix_names)) +  # reverse Y-axis
  scale_x_discrete(limits = matrix_names) +  # non reversed X-axis
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(x = "", y = "", title = "Wet History") +
  #theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(),
  axis.text = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
  axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
  axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
  panel.grid.major = element_blank(),  # remove major grid lines
  panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),  # remove minor grid lines
  axis.line = element_blank()          # optional: remove axis lines
)
```

# Plotting

```{r field sample chemistry by history}
# Plot
chem_vars <- c("P.ppm", "K.ppm", "Mg.ppm", "Ca.ppm", "pH", "S.ppm", "B.ppm",
               "Zn.ppm", "Mn.ppm", "Fe.ppm", "Cu.ppm", "HM.", "CEC.")

field_chem_long <- soil_hist_F |>
  pivot_longer(all_of(chem_vars), names_to = "Variable", values_to = "Value") |>
  mutate(Variable = factor(Variable, levels = chem_vars))

field_chem_plot <- ggplot(field_chem_long, aes(x = history, y = Value)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.15, height = 0) +
  facet_wrap(~ Variable, scales = "free_y", ncol = 4) +
  labs(x = "soil history", y = NULL, title = "") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    # Grid
    panel.grid.major    = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor    = element_blank(),
    # Panel & border
    panel.border        = element_rect(colour = "black", linewidth = 1),
    # Axis
    axis.title          = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
    axis.text           = element_text(size = 10, color = "black"),
    axis.ticks.length   = unit(0.3, "cm"),
    # Text & strips
    text                = element_text(size = 10),
    strip.text          = element_text(size = 10),
    # Legend
    legend.position     = "right",
    legend.title        = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.text         = element_text(size = 10),
    # Background
    rect                = element_rect(fill = "transparent"),
    plot.background     = element_rect(color = NA)
  )
 
field_chem_plot
```

## Post incubation soil Fe and S concentrations

```{r}
library(emmeans)

# Extract EMMs for Iron (Fe)
emms_Fe <- emmeans(model_Fe, ~ treatment * plant * history)
df_Fe <- as.data.frame(emms_Fe)

# Extract EMMs for Sulfur (S)
emms_S <- emmeans(model_S, ~ treatment * plant * history)
df_S <- as.data.frame(emms_S)
```

```{r Fe emmean plot}
# Define a clean dodge width to prevent overlapping error bars
pd <- position_dodge(0.4)

plot_Fe <- ggplot(df_Fe, aes(x = treatment, y = emmean, color = plant, group = plant)) +
  # Add error bars for the 95% confidence intervals
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = lower.CL, ymax = upper.CL), width = 0.2, position = pd, linewidth = 0.8) +
  # Add points for the estimated means
  geom_point(position = pd, size = 3) +
  # Add lines connecting the means to highlight the interaction slopes
  geom_line(position = pd, size = 1, alpha = 0.7) +
  # Facet by historical field conditions
  facet_wrap(~ history, labeller = labeller(history = c("D" = "History: Dry", "W" = "History: Wet"))) +
  # Clean aesthetics
  theme_pubr() +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("N" = "#D55E00", "P" = "#009E73"), 
                     labels = c("No Plant", "Plant")) +
  labs(
    title = "Extractable Soil Iron Response to Hydrologic Shifts",
    x = "Lab Incubation Hydrology",
    y = "Estimated Marginal Mean Fe (ppm)",
    color = "Sub-plot Treatment"
  ) +
  theme(legend.position = "right", strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"))

plot_Fe
```
